resources.string: Six contracts to bring the forge to life. Match metals, clear slag and deliver the energy core. No timer.

Swap two neighbouring pieces to align at least three identical metals. Swipe, or tap two pieces.\n\nTilt your phone to direct falling pieces, even during cascades. The board stays fixed; pieces fall towards physical down.
Match the requested metal. Only successful swaps cost a move; cascades are free.
Match pieces on the scratched brown cells to clean them.
Each core has its own exit, shown by its green arrow. Other edges do not deliver it. Tilt the device and clear a path around rivets.
Collect both metals. Riveted pieces stay fixed: guide the pieces around them.
This piece is riveted: it cannot move and survives explosions. Go around it.
4 aligned pieces: clear the entire line.\nAn L or T: explode at the junction within a radius of 3 cells.\nCores and rivets survive bonuses.
Tilt. Match. Fire up the forge.
Metals, slag and cores to deliver.
Varied boards and obstacles, one core at a time.\nFrom board 5: two cores, two directions. From board 9: three.
Clean increasingly coated boards. Double layers at board 4, beams at 6, blasts at 8 and triple layers at 10.
Race for a high score against the clock. Every match restores time: aim for four in a row and L/T shapes to blast the board!

Score: 10 points per piece, 40 per special line and 100 per explosion. Cascades multiply these points up to ×5. Delivering a core earns 250 points. Finishing a board earns 100 points plus 15 per remaining move.

The clock only tracks play time: there is no time limit. It pauses in menus, in the background and between boards.

Retrying resets the current board score, keeping points from previous boards and total play time.
